SetupPreviewCli.Heading: Planned Supabase application setup
SetupPreviewCli.Introduction: These questions preview the work a future CLI release will perform. Your answers are not saved and no services, files or projects are changed.
SetupPreviewCli.WarningDetail: This answer will not be saved and no action will be performed.
SetupPreviewCli.ConfigIntroduction: Define the application behaviour that a completed installer would write to developer-owned src/supacharger.config.ts.
SetupPreviewCli.NonNegativeInteger: Enter zero or a positive whole number.
SetupPreviewCli.SiteTitleQuestion: Application title — used as the default product name
SetupPreviewCli.SiteDescriptionQuestion: Application description — used as the default metadata description
SetupPreviewCli.MarketingUrlQuestion: Separate marketing-site URL — press Enter if this application has no separate marketing site
SetupPreviewCli.SiteIdentityAction:
WRITE
  Update SITE_TITLE to '{title}'.
  Update SITE_DESCRIPTION to '{description}'.
  Update MARKETING_SITE_URL to {marketingUrl}.
  Preserve translations and every unrelated SC_CONFIG property.
SetupPreviewCli.IndexingQuestion: Should search engines be allowed to index this application?
SetupPreviewCli.FaviconQuestion: Should Supacharger's standard favicon manifest be enabled?
SetupPreviewCli.ColourSchemeQuestion: Which browser colour scheme should the application declare?
SetupPreviewCli.ThemeColourQuestion: Theme colour — enter one CSS colour, or press Enter to omit the theme-colour tag
SetupPreviewCli.OgUrlQuestion: Default social-preview image URL — press Enter to omit the default image
SetupPreviewCli.OgWidthQuestion: Default social-preview image width in pixels
SetupPreviewCli.OgHeightQuestion: Default social-preview image height in pixels
SetupPreviewCli.MetadataAction:
WRITE
  Keep METADATA.SITE_URL derived from getSiteUrl() and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.
  Set METADATA.INDEXING_ENABLED to {indexing}.
  Set METADATA.FAVICON_SET_ENABLED to {favicons}.
  Set METADATA.COLOR_SCHEME to '{colourScheme}'.
  Set METADATA.THEME_COLOR to {themeColour}.
  Set METADATA.DEFAULT_OG_IMAGE.DEFAULT to {ogImage}.
  Preserve locale-specific OG images unless the user explicitly configures them.
SetupPreviewCli.TermsRequiredQuestion: Must users accept signup terms before creating an account?
SetupPreviewCli.TermsUrlQuestion: Signup terms path or absolute URL — press Enter to use no terms link
SetupPreviewCli.ConfirmedPathQuestion: Where should users be sent after account confirmation?
SetupPreviewCli.TermsAction:
WRITE
  Set AUTHENTICATION.SIGN_UP_TERMS.REQUIRED to {required}.
  Set AUTHENTICATION.SIGN_UP_TERMS.URL.DEFAULT to {url} while preserving locale-specific URLs.
  Set AUTHENTICATION.ACCOUNT_CONFIRMED_PATH to '{confirmedPath}'.

VERIFY
  Validate configured paths as safe application-relative paths or permitted absolute URLs.
SetupPreviewCli.OtpLengthQuestion: How many digits should Supabase Auth email OTP codes contain?
SetupPreviewCli.PlusAddressingQuestion: Should email addresses containing plus aliases be accepted?
SetupPreviewCli.ResendCooldownQuestion: How many seconds must users wait before resending an authentication email?
SetupPreviewCli.PasswordPolicyQuestion: Which built-in password character policy should Supacharger enforce?
SetupPreviewCli.MinimumLengthQuestion: What minimum password length should Supacharger enforce?
SetupPreviewCli.PasswordRegexQuestion: Additional password regular expression — press Enter for none
SetupPreviewCli.AuthPolicyAction:
WRITE
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.METHODS.PASSWORDLESS_EMAIL.OTP_LENGTH to {otpLength}.
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.EMAIL.ALLOW_PLUS_ADDRESSING to {plusAddressing}.
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.EMAIL.RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS to {resendCooldown}.
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.PASSWORD.REQUIREMENTS to '{passwordPolicy}'.
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.PASSWORD.MINIMUM_LENGTH to {minimumLength}.
  Set SUPABASE_AUTH.PASSWORD.CUSTOM_REGEX to {passwordRegex}.

SUPABASE ALIGNMENT
  Set auth.email.otp_length in supabase/config.toml and the hosted Supabase Email OTP length to {otpLength}.

VERIFY
  Compile the custom regular expression before writing and reject invalid or unsafe values.
SetupPreviewCli.AuthOnlyQuestion: Should every non-allowlisted application route require authentication?
SetupPreviewCli.UsernameQuestion: Should user names be disabled, optional or required?
SetupPreviewCli.AvatarQuestion: Should user avatars be disabled or optional?
SetupPreviewCli.HeaderImageQuestion: Should user header images be disabled or optional?
SetupPreviewCli.OnboardingQuestion: Should users complete profile onboarding after signing in?
SetupPreviewCli.ProfileAction:
WRITE
  Set AUTH_ONLY_APP to {authOnly}.
  Set PROFILE_IDENTITY.USERNAME to '{username}'.
  Set PROFILE_IDENTITY.AVATAR to '{avatar}'.
  Set PROFILE_IDENTITY.HEADER_IMAGE to '{headerImage}'.
  Set POST_SIGN_IN_ONBOARDING.REQUIRED to {onboarding}.
  Set POST_SIGN_IN_ONBOARDING.REDIRECT_PATH to '{onboardingPath}'.

VERIFY
  Confirm required profile fields have a reachable onboarding route outside the onboarding guard.
SetupPreviewCli.OrganisationsQuestion: Should organisation journeys and organisation context be enabled?
SetupPreviewCli.OrganisationHandleQuestion: Should an organisation handle be disabled, optional or required during authentication?
SetupPreviewCli.OrganisationMediaQuestion: Should organisation profile media be enabled?
SetupPreviewCli.OrganisationsAction:
WRITE
  Set ORGANISATIONS.ENABLED to {enabled}.
  Set ORGANISATIONS.AUTHENTICATION_HANDLE to '{handle}'.
  Set ORGANISATIONS.PROFILE_MEDIA to {media}.
  Preserve the contracted CHOOSER_PATH and ROUTE_MODE values.

VERIFY
  Confirm organisation routes, adapters and selected authentication fields are compatible with these settings.
SetupPreviewCli.LocalQuestion: Do you intend to set up Supabase for local development?
SetupPreviewCli.LocalAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

COMMANDS
  npm install
  npx supabase --version
  docker info
  npx supabase start
  npx supabase status --output json

WRITE
  Read the local API URL and keys from Supabase status. Merge them into .env.local without replacing unrelated developer values.

DATABASE
  Run npx supabase db push --local, then run the project's type-generation command.

VERIFY
  Confirm the local services are healthy and list local migration status with npx supabase migration list --local.
SetupPreviewCli.HostedQuestion: Do you intend to connect this installation to a hosted Supabase project?
SetupPreviewCli.HostedAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

DETAILS
  Read the project reference from the Project Overview URL: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/<project-ref>. Request the database password using non-echoing input; it is the password chosen when the project was created or later reset under Project Settings > Database.

COMMANDS
  npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
  npx supabase db push --linked --dry-run

GATE
  Display every pending migration and request separate confirmation before changing the hosted database.

APPLY
  npx supabase db push --linked

VERIFY
  npx supabase migration list --linked
  Read the linked project status without printing or storing the database password.
SetupPreviewCli.AuthMethodsQuestion: Which Supabase Auth sign-in methods do you intend to enable?
SetupPreviewCli.AuthMethodsAction:
SELECTION
  {selection}

WRITE
  Update only the matching SUPABASE_AUTH.METHODS and OAuth provider entries in src/supacharger.config.ts. Preserve every unrelated developer-owned setting.
  Update the equivalent local Auth settings in supabase/config.toml.

HOSTED CHANGE
  Apply the selected provider settings through the Supabase Management API after explicit authorisation. Request provider secrets with masked input; never write them to the repository or terminal output.
  Calculate hosted OAuth callbacks as https://<project-ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback.

VERIFY
  Read the resulting Auth configuration back and compare it with src/supacharger.config.ts.
SetupPreviewCli.VerificationQuestion: Which Supabase Auth sign-up email verification behaviour do you intend to use?
VerificationChoices: Supabase Auth — Email OTP and verification link
SetupPreviewCli.VerificationAction:
SELECTION
  {selection}

WRITE
  Set SIGN_UP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION in src/supacharger.config.ts and align supabase/config.toml.

HOSTED CHANGE
  Update the linked project's Supabase Auth confirmation setting and the relevant email template through the Management API.

VERIFY
  Create a disposable test sign-up and confirm that Supabase sends or suppresses verification using the selected behaviour.
SetupPreviewCli.HookQuestion: Do you intend to enable Supacharger's Supabase Auth Custom Access Token Hook?
SetupPreviewCli.HookAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

DATABASE
  Confirm the Core migration defining app.custom_access_token_hook is present locally and in the linked project.

HOSTED CHANGE
  Register app.custom_access_token_hook as the project's Supabase Auth Custom Access Token Hook through the Management API.

VERIFY
  Create a test session, decode its access token locally and confirm the expected application claims are present. No token is printed.
SetupPreviewCli.EmailQuestion: Do you intend to configure Supabase Auth email delivery?
SetupPreviewCli.EmailAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

LOCAL
  Keep local Auth mail routed to the mail catcher supplied by npx supabase start and obtain its address from npx supabase status.

HOSTED CHANGE
  Offer the hosted Supabase default mail service or custom SMTP. For custom SMTP, request credentials using masked input and send them directly to the Management API; never persist or print the password.

VERIFY
  Read back non-secret SMTP settings and send a disposable Supabase Auth email.
SetupPreviewCli.TemplateQuestion: Do you intend to install Supacharger's Supabase Auth email templates?
SetupPreviewCli.TemplateAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

READ
  Map the selected Supabase Auth flows to the canonical templates under resources/sc-email-templates/supabase.

HOSTED CHANGE
  Read the current hosted Auth templates, replace only the selected template bodies through the Management API and preserve unrelated templates and settings.

VERIFY
  Read each changed template back and compare it with the canonical source before sending a test email.
SetupPreviewCli.MediaQuestion: Do you intend to set up Supacharger profile media and image uploads?
SetupPreviewCli.MediaAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

DATABASE
  Apply the Core migrations that create the required Storage buckets, tables and row-level security policies.

SECRET
  Transfer the generated namespaced image-upload signing secret from .env.local to a temporary restricted environment file, run npx supabase secrets set --env-file <temporary-file>, then securely remove the temporary file. The value is never placed in command arguments or logs.

VERIFY
  Test an authenticated upload, confirm the processing path and verify that another user cannot access protected objects.
SetupPreviewCli.FunctionQuestion: Do you intend to deploy Supacharger's Supabase Edge Functions?
SetupPreviewCli.FunctionAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

COMMANDS
  Discover functions from supabase/functions and show the deployment list.
  npx supabase functions deploy <function-name>

SECRETS
  Identify each function's required secrets and set only missing values with npx supabase secrets set --env-file <temporary-file>.

VERIFY
  Invoke each deployed function with a safe test request and inspect its Supabase function logs on failure.
SetupPreviewCli.McpQuestion: Do you intend to connect the project-scoped Supabase MCP server for agent development?
SetupPreviewCli.McpAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

WRITE
  Add a project-scoped Supabase MCP entry to the supported local agent configuration, preserving every existing MCP server.

AUTHORISE
  Print the Supabase OAuth authorisation link. Do not open a browser automatically.

VERIFY
  Confirm the MCP endpoint is reachable and perform a read-only project identity check before exposing project tools.
SetupPreviewCli.LaunchQuestion: Should the completed setup launch Supacharger locally when every required check passes?
SetupPreviewCli.LaunchAction:
SELECTION
  {answer}

PRE-FLIGHT
  Check required environment values, dependency installation, Docker, local Supabase health, migration status and generated database types.

COMMANDS
  Start local Supabase if required with npx supabase start.
  Start the application with npm run dev after the Core development-port contract has been aligned to 3000.

VERIFY
  Poll http://localhost:3000 until it returns an HTTP response. Print the URL only after the application is reachable; otherwise retain the application log and show the failing check.
